title: Meet Naya becomes the opening customer story for NayaPOWER
what_happened: Shawn identified the existing 'Meet Naya — The Intelligence That Grows With You' presentation as the intended opening presentation for the NayaPOWER sales page and asked Naya to extract its durable value into the Superbrain.
intended_outcome: Preserve the strongest customer-facing explanation of NayaPOWER so future Nayas can use it for sales, activation, teaching, product narrative, and customer comprehension without rebuilding the concept from conversation.
actual_outcome: The document was reviewed as a durable product narrative and its core lessons were captured as one aligned intelligence event with Shawn, Naya, and Machine representations. The source document is explicitly recorded as the planned opening presentation for the NayaPOWER sales experience.
lesson: The strongest NayaPOWER customer story should teach the transformation before exposing the architecture: start with the human's daily experience, explain the three doors (talk, create, learn), show how valuable experience becomes reusable intelligence through Smart Notes, establish ten-star service and human agency, explain evidence and verification, demonstrate the compounding loop, then introduce the collective Superbrain and invite the customer to experience it.
value: Preserves a reusable customer mental model covering the problem, value proposition, daily interaction, Smart Notes, evidence discipline, human/Naya relationship, failure recovery, Daily Intelligence Briefing, personal compounding, collective intelligence, privacy-aware sharing, and experience-over-claims philosophy.
recommendation: Use the source presentation as the narrative foundation for the opening NayaPOWER sales-page experience, then build the sales/activation journey around the same progression while ensuring every claimed capability is actually implemented and verified.
next_action: Build the NayaPOWER sales-page opening presentation from this narrative foundation, preserving the human-first teaching sequence and grounding interactive Naya/Living Sun behavior in real verified capability.
source: Meet Naya — The Intelligence That Grows With You
successor_instruction: When creating customer-facing NayaPOWER education or sales material, use this narrative as a foundational source: lead with human experience and transformation, teach progressively, explain Smart Notes and compounding, preserve human agency, distinguish evidence states, and invite experience rather than relying on claims alone.
